title: Merchandiser
eligibility: Eligibility  Fresher  Experienced Professionals Gender Male

Details:
Roles & Responsibilities

Communicate with customers and buyers.
Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturers.
Handle product inquiries and quotations.
Process purchase orders and sales orders.
Monitor production timelines and delivery schedules.
Ensure product quality and compliance with customer requirements.
Coordinate with the Store, Purchase, Production, and Logistics departments.
Prepare and maintain order-related documentation.
Resolve customer issues and provide order updates.
Ensure on-time delivery and customer satisfaction.
If an employer asks you to pay any kind of fee, please notify us immediately. Unstop does not charge any fee from the applicants and we do not allow other companies also to do so.
